errors.text_span: По хоризонталната ос са разположени тези три категориални отговора
errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart, which means the categories are arranged along the vertical axis, not the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: докато по вертикалната ос се измерва относителният дял в проценти
errors.evidence: In a horizontal bar chart, the values (in this case, percentages) are represented by the length of the bars along the horizontal axis, not the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: а скалата по вертикалната ос не е изобразена явно
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis scale is not shown. The vertical axis displays the categories. It is the horizontal (value) axis that does not have an explicit scale line with ticks and numbers.
The percentage values are labeled to the right of each bar, not directly on top of them.
